sense.text:
“The wicked are estranged from the womb”: if you didn’t know, the so-called white man is the wicked. “They go astray as soon as they be born”: they are born evil. And what do they do? “Speaking lies.”

You don’t have to take anybody’s word for it. Look up the so-called white man and check his track record: everything he tells you is a lie. He gave the Indians blankets and gave them diseases. He told black people they were getting 40 acres and a mule. He told you black men are bad. He told you Jesus was white, and that December 24th was Jesus’ birthday. Lies. The levees in Katrina, 9/11 an inside job, the weapons of mass destruction in Iraq, Venezuela, troops and bombs sent to Nigeria when no African country holds a nuclear weapon or is a threat to anyone: lies. This man is a born liar.

That is why the black newscaster on air telling Donald Trump, you are making it hard for us to support you, is only appealing to the white man: I want to support you, master, but you make it hard.

“Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear.” Black people have been asking for justice since the time we got over here; every leader has asked the white man for justice, and he does not hear you. This nation does not hear anything you have to say. It is a deaf adder that stops its own ear.

precepts.why:
“Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.” All you have to do is read that one verse: it is the wicked of Psalms 58:3 “speaking lies.” His mouth is given to evil, and his tongue frames deceit.

The Flower Moon story shows it: they all moved in, killed the women and took all the land. He is a liar, and it is evident. If you don’t want to believe it, that’s fine: go ahead and sign a deal with him and watch what happens.

sense.text:
“And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.” The serpent is that old serpent, the devil, and the flood out of his mouth is his lies, carried out after the woman to carry her away.

That flood runs through social media today. The curses say we would have no might, but social media is power, and they are showing it. Netanyahu himself says you cannot fight with swords today, that the most important weapons are social media, and TikTok number one: not the nuclear weapon, not the atomic bomb, not troops. When the understanding of who we are drops and the children of Israel are waking up, that is more dangerous to them than a bomb ever can be.

They cannot bomb us, because they need the workforce, so they have to control our minds to keep our bodies. Whoever has the children of Israel in captivity runs the earth: Assyria, Babylon, Persia, Greece, Rome, Spain and Portugal, Great Britain, and America. The jewels of God are in their possession, and those jewels are on TikTok doing dances. What they don’t want is a brother getting on there telling you who you are.

So TikTok was not banned because China had it. It was in the wrong hands, and they had to get it back into the hands of the right one, as they see it: forced to sell to a board led by Oracle, a company built to manage databases for the CIA, whose founder is one of the biggest donors to Israel’s army. It is about controlling the narrative, carrying out their lies.

“Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed.” America says it has the Constitution, freedom of speech, the first amendment. Then why the hell are they trying to control narratives? Why do you need to control the narrative? Power. That is the hypocrisy: this place is the hypocritical nation.

“I will send him against an hypocritical nation.” America is a hypocritical nation; understand that. “And against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.” The same way he dealt with Assyria is the same way America is going to get dealt with.

“But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost.” This is absolute war, and social media is where the war is fought. A TikTok that gained 50,000 followers in five months has gained about a hundred in the three months since the takeover. The same style of videos that went to 500,000 and a million views now get a thousand, marked ineligible for recommendation. Bishop was sent the notice: your content can’t be shown to people who don’t follow you. A social media platform is for being social, for meeting new people, and they say, we are not showing your stuff to anybody new. The gospel is being hid.

It was the same thing at the time of Christ: they said the disciples would steal the body and set a watch, because they did not want the truth to spread.

“In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.” The god of this world is blinding minds over social media, so that the light does not shine unto them.

Why don’t they do that to Christianity? Christianity is not losing any views. If what we teach is a lie, why are they worried, and why don’t they ban them as well? They won’t, and that should show dumb black people that what we teach is true. They don’t want you to know.

“Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.” This is the same scripture in today’s light. They gather and say, we have to get control of these social media accounts: they have thousands of teachers, on Clubhouse all day, the morning classes, the radio shows day and night, and brothers on the streets. The nations can’t sleep; we are giving these nations problems.

What we do is not normal. Two, three, four thousand men, women and children in unity all over the world; a thousand brothers walking through the streets of Madagascar; women dressed modestly, which the other camps cannot imagine. That is a miracle.

“If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him.” If they left us alone, if they did not call us a hate group, ban us from countries and put out all these false narratives, everybody would believe. That is why they had Bishop’s YouTube deleted back around 2007: they saw twenty years ahead, they saw that algorithm coming, and said we have to do something now.

“And the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.” A lot of people are puppets. Black people have no use to these people; the only use they have is that they can sway the masses of black people. If they are not swaying the masses and we are, they have no use for them, so these men have to be put out of the way. It is being done on social media now, and eventually it will be physical. When they reach out and touch us, that is when it is time to get out of here, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

precepts.why:
“He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.” Everything they create, we use against them, and that is why they say they cannot stop us. Now they have made AI and they would put it back in the box if they could, but we have it, and we are better at it than everybody else.

Even hiding us on social media only gives us more clout. People ask why they never see us anywhere, and the answer is that they are trying to hide us. It adds validity and proves the point.

“He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.” All of this was created for them to monitor us. They never knew we would use it to teach: Clubhouse teaching the Bible day and night, YouTube made for silly videos now carrying movies, hours of teaching, a twelve-hour stream against Christmas on Christmas. Their counsel is carried headlong, cast down. So when they say, if we let him thus alone all men will believe, their own devices are already turned against them.

“They conferred among themselves, Saying, What shall we do to these men?” That is what they are doing now: conferring among themselves over these men in purple. “For that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem”, the Israelites, “and we cannot deny it.” They cannot deny what is happening.

“But that it spread no further among the people”: that is the algorithm. “Let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.” “And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.” It is the same council as John 11, gathered against the apostles, and the same thing being done to us on the platforms. They cannot stand it, because they see the end.

sense.text:
“Watch and pray.” We have to go back through the year so you can understand what times we are in. You can see the dragon is rough with us; he controls and manipulates everything; he is the hidden hand behind the earth. Trump and Zelenskyy showed it this year: the white man saying, have you said thank you, do you know who you are talking to? It is the same thing the black politician for Trump was saying, and what he is saying to the other nations: do you not know I’m your daddy, I can do whatever I want to you, you ungrateful heathen; y’all need me, I don’t need you. A lot have forgotten all of it; they have been sleeping.

“Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

“And when these things begin to come to pass”: the persecution. Us being stoned, us being outlawed in France, brothers and sisters losing their jobs. All of it leads up to the ultimate persecution, when we will be put to death.

“Then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.” Christ is coming.
